name: inline-ai-suggestions
description: Inline code completions using OpenAI Chat Completions, OpenAI Responses, or Anthropic Messages.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Inline AI Suggestions sends bounded source context to the configured API endpoint.

inlineAi.enabled.description: Enable automatic AI inline suggestions. No request is made until a model and API key are configured.

inlineAi.apiFormat.description: Wire protocol used by the configured API.

inlineAi.baseUrl.markdownDescription: Versioned API root without the operation path. Empty uses `https://api.openai.com/v1` or `https://api.anthropic.com/v1`, based on the selected API format.

enumDescriptions: Modern OpenAI Chat Completions field, required by newer reasoning models.
Legacy field used by many OpenAI-compatible gateways.
inlineAi.chatTokenField.description: Output-token field used only with the OpenAI Chat Completions format.

inlineAi.model.description: Model identifier accepted by the configured endpoint.

inlineAi.debounceMs.description: Delay before an automatic completion request. Explicit requests are immediate.

inlineAi.requestTimeoutMs.description: Maximum duration of a completion request.

inlineAi.maxOutputTokens.description: Maximum number of tokens generated for one suggestion.

inlineAi.maxPrefixCharacters.description: Maximum source characters sent from before the cursor.

inlineAi.maxSuffixCharacters.description: Maximum source characters sent from after the cursor.

inlineAi.maxSuggestionCharacters.description: Maximum number of characters accepted in a returned suggestion.

inlineAi.excludedLanguages.description: VS Code language identifiers for which requests are disabled.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
